title: feat(service-knowledge): search answers records, not passages — granularity, groupBy and a freshness check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8KwgBifx8qqSVYdsjkfntXZ)_

Fixes #37103

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` teaches the knowledge search options or the hit's shape (the one knowledge eval asks about source authoring); `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` teach them, updated here.

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:应用检索知识时可以选「按记录返回」:同一份制度命中多个片段只返回一条（取最高分），也可以按某个字段分组（比如按制度）直接得到「哪几份制度」；默认行为不变。
- 为什么做:知识检索平台化专题第二阶段，让制度问询先找到「哪几份制度」再交给模型，应用不用再自己去重。
- 出错会怎样:只影响主动选了按记录返回的检索；建索引后被删、改过或不再符合条件的记录不会返回旧片段，并在后台自动修一次索引；可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- `KnowledgeSearchOptions` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts`) gains `granularity?: 'chunk' | 'record'` (default `chunk`: the same hits, asks and reads as today, no extra read; on `knowledge-memory` each hit now also carries `docHash` and, when its passage has one, `headingPath`, the K8 items 3 and 14 members) and `groupBy?: string`. The return type stays `KnowledgeHit[]`.
- `KnowledgeHitSchema` gains `docHash?` (ADR-0161 K8 item 3) and `headingPath?` (item 14); `knowledge-memory` returns both on its hits.
- `KnowledgeService.search()` under record granularity:
  - one hit per record, its best passage; `topK` counts records. Every source is asked `topK × 5` and the saturated ones refilled once at `topK × 20` when fewer than `topK` groups survive (the existing refill of #36993, widened to every source and caller in this mode). That refill is the stated cap; fewer records within it answer fewer, logged at `debug`.
  - `groupBy` groups by `metadata[groupBy]`; same value = one group across sources; an object source without the field in `metadataFields` is not searched; a record with no value is not answered; file / http sources group by document. `groupBy` implies record mode; with `granularity: 'chunk'` it is refused (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, 400, never ignored), as are an empty `groupBy` and an unknown `granularity`; the caller's `groupBy` is JSON-quoted and cut at 64 characters in log lines and refusals.
  - The permission re-read stays one query as the caller and also reads the display field (`documentTitleField`, the `resolveDisplayField` reading shared with #36994); a caller's hit carries the live `title`. The system identity is not re-checked, so its hits keep the indexed title (equal whenever the hash matched).
  - Freshness: only for the hits about to be answered, one system-context read per source, `{ $and: [where, { id: { $in } }] }`, projected to the fields assembly reads (the whole row when the source names a field the object does not declare), its system context in the trailing options argument. Deleted / out-of-`where` / recomputed-`docHash`-differs ⇒ dropped, next group moves up (at most `SEARCH_FRESHNESS_ROUNDS` = 3 rounds; unchecked after that ⇒ not answered). Repair: `syncRecord` through the per-document serialization (#36991's path), not awaited, system context, single-flight, once per document until a later search finds its hash matching; never throws into the search. A source with `refresh.onRecordChange: false` (external indexer) is never repaired: `repairStale` asks `objectSourcesFor` first, and the stale hit is only dropped. A hit without a stored hash is checked for membership only. A failed freshness read drops that source's checked hits (fail-closed), `warn`.
- Contract suite (`@objectstack/service-knowledge/testing`): an adapter with `listDocuments` must return each hit's stored `docHash` (plus a record-level freshness case through a real service); an adapter that takes chunks must return `headingPath`. The chunk stub in `contract-stubs.test.ts` now carries `headingPath`.
- Docs: `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` gains "Records, not passages"; `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` shows `granularity` / `groupBy`; `content/docs/references/ai/knowledge-document.mdx` and `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json` regenerated.

## Why

Epic #37000 phase 2 row 10, ADR-0161 K1 (record-level return; the service groups, K8 item 13 stays out). Out of scope as the card says: `search_knowledge` tool arguments (row 12), grouping inside the adapter, the scope filter (row 11).

## Acceptance notes

- Reading choice, stated: card item 3's "File and http sources group by `documentId`" is applied under `groupBy` too (a file document is its own group beside the field's values), and the rule "a source without it answers no hits" applies to object sources.
- Reading choice, stated: freshness and the live title run only under record granularity, so the default `chunk` mode is today's behaviour (card item 1).
- Coordination: #37100 (`knowledge-pgvector`) runs the contract suite; with `listDocuments` it now owes `docHash` on hits, and with chunks `headingPath`. Told to that thread.
- Declaration corrected from the claim's `Metadata-protocol: none` to `added` (and `@objectstack/spec` to `minor`): `Check Changeset` reads the two new `KnowledgeHit` keys in `authorable-surface/ai.json` as authorable keys added. Seat told to align the claim.
- `freshnessRepairs` holds one entry per stale document until its hash is seen matching; a record deleted for good keeps its entry for the process lifetime (bounded by distinct stale records seen). Row 15 moves repair to the queue.

## Tests

<details><summary>Local runs at f5c87f79</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge test` → Test Files 11 passed, Tests 296 passed (275 before; +20 record-level cases in `knowledge-service.test.ts`, +1 contract headingPath case on the chunk stub).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-memory exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` → Tests 37 passed (contract: hit docHash, record-level freshness through a real service with background repair, headingPath).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-ragflow exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` → Tests 10 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-memory typecheck` → exit 0, test-typecheck OK.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → 1 stale (`check:docs`), fixed with `--fix`, re-check green; other 13 green.
- `check:system-context-census`, `check:where-matcher`, `check:doc-anchors` → green (the first two were red in CI at 4267fda8 and are fixed: the contract double no longer reads `isSystem`, and the record-level suite's table engine refuses operators it does not implement).
- eslint on the changed `.ts` files → exit 0. `check:doc-authoring`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check-nul-bytes` → exit 0.
- Ablation (restored, `git diff HEAD` empty): hash compare replaced by `false` → 2 freshness cases red; grouping map read disabled → 3 grouping cases red. Review round (at f5c87f79): repair skip removed → the external-indexer case red; `SEARCH_FRESHNESS_ROUNDS` 3 → 50 → the round-cap case red; undeclared-field filter restored → the undeclared-field case red; title dropped from the projection → 2 cases red; the cap-aware debug guard removed → the round-cap case red.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the full `pnpm test` / repo `check:*` farm (117 derived commands) — declared to CI.
</details>

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/knowledge-service.test.ts -t "record-level"` → 20 passed.

Read first: `knowledge-service.ts` `answerByRecord` + `checkFreshness` (drop/repair decisions), `search()` (refill widening under record mode), `applyPermissionFilter` (live title projection).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on changed files passes (repo `pnpm lint` in CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
